chunks: Al-Washshā' narrated to me, saying: Aḥmad ibn ʿUmar al-Ḥallāl narrated to us, saying:

I said to Abī al-Ḥasan (عليه السلام): Inform me about the one from the children of Fāṭimah who opposes you and does not recognize your right—would he and the rest of the people be equal in punishment? He said: ʿAlī ibn al-Ḥusayn (عليه السلام) used to say: Upon them is a double punishment.

key_terms.حَقَّكَ: your rightful claim and due authority
key_terms.عَانَدَكَ: opposed you stubbornly and acted in defiance

ai.seo_question: Are those from the children of Fāṭimah who reject the Imam punished more severely than others?
ai.summary: This hadith addresses the grave consequence of opposing the Imam and failing to acknowledge his right, even among those from the descendants of Fāṭimah. It indicates that such denial carries a more severe punishment, highlighting the seriousness of knowingly rejecting divinely established religious authority.
